data.notes: The 12-search budget was fully used, following the 80/20 approach. Values come mainly from ADAC Autokatalog pages and VW official pages (volkswagen.de, volkswagen.at, a VW press spec PDF), with auto motor und sport, carwow and secondary sites as fallback. Facelifts are only split out where something relevant changed: the Golf 8 vs 8.5 dimensions changed by 1-2 mm and the PHEV changed from 1.4 to 1.5 eHybrid, and the ID.3 facelift changed length and height. The Golf Variant and Polo facelifts are folded into one generation because ADAC reports unchanged or near-identical dimensions and trunk. The ID.5 was added as the clearly missing coupe sibling of the ID.4. Other same-segment VW models (T-Roc, T-Cross, Taigo, Golf Sportsvan) were not added and are assumed to be covered by other lists. Plug-in hybrids have a smaller trunk only in the Golf hatch (273/1129 l vs 381/1237 l). Mild hybrids keep the full trunk. None of the BEVs (ID.3, ID.4, ID.5) has a frunk.
